page.layout: One column of running text, with no marginal notes. Top left: the page number "34". Centred running head "VITA". Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: sticorum[?] distinctionibus profert, qvæ haud dubie Morino aliud cogitanti exciderunt :: vix enim umbraticorum ejusmodi doctorum scholas à limine salutaverat ; præclare qvidem interdum sentit de Hieronymi, qvem merito vulgatæ, saltem partem maximam, autorem putat, peritia in Lingua Hebraica ; alias verò illum infectatur velut hominem parum sibi constantem, qviqve sæpius loqvatur ex anteceptis opinionibus, qvàm ex rerum ipsarum veritate.

SED rigidus iste censor, qvi adeo iniqvum de Judæis & eorum codicibus judicium tulerat, illorum, qvorum intere-rat, veritatem Hebraicam asserere maledicta in caput suum attraxit, atqve inprimis eruditissimi viri Simeonis de Muis, tunc literarum Hebraearum apud Parisios Professoris Regii. Is scilicet de arte sua actum judicans, nisi Morini audaciam reprimeret, scripsit paulo iracundior libellum adversus Ecclesiasticas illius exercitationes in Pentateuchum Samaritanum ; scriptum qvoqve accerbissimum

page.notes: Top-left page number is a decorated "34", read as 34. Word at the start of the page is cut off at the left edge ("sticorum", probably "scholasticorum"), so it is marked [?]. "Professoris" is set with a ligature, and I have read it as Professoris. The ending of "intere-rat" is a line-end break and is read as printed. The scan is slightly blurred around the right margin and the lower lines, but the text is legible.
